out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE MORE STAFF RECEIVE A CERTIFICATION AND THAT A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. ASIAN GARDEN (Inspection Date: 08/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHRIMP STORED OVER CARROTS IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION AND EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE ON PROPER RAW ORGANIZATION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SHREDDED CABBAGE AT 48-50F, PORK DUMPLINGS AT 48F, COOKED NOODLES AT 67F, AND BOK CHOY AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS ARE ALWAYS KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Cannot Exceed 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item for which time rather than temperature is being used as a control was not cooked, served or discarded by the expiration time as indicated: OBSERVED SHREDDED CABBAGE ON COUNTER-TOP LABELED WITH A 4 HOUR TIME MARKING AND WAS NOT DISCARDED BY THE END POINT (APPROXIMATELY 30 MINUTES AFTER).
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours is used as the public health control : 1) the food shall have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature or, 2) the food shall have an initial temperature of 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 3) the food shall be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 4) the food shall be cooked and served, served if ready to eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 5) the food if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit shall be discarded. EHS REVIEWED TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL REQUIREMENTS AND PIC DISCARDED OF CABBAGE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED CHICKEN WINGS THAWING ON A SHELF IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER THAWING METHODS AGAIN. PIC MOVED CHICKEN TO THE WALK-IN COOLER. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: GARLIC PEEL, CHICKEN BASE, AND CANNED FOOD manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE DISCONTINUE USING THESE CONTAINERS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED/DURABLE AND ARE NOT MADE TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED GROCERY BAGS USED TO DIRECTLY STORE VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN/COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. PLEASE DO NOT STORE FOOD ITEMS DIRECTLY IN GROCERY BAGS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED/FOOD GRADE.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE RIGHT TWO-DOOR PREP- TOP AT 48-50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC DISCARDED TCS FOODS OUT OF TEMPERATURE OR MOVED THEM TO ANOTHER COOLER. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND IS NOT USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS TCS FOODS ON TIME SHOULD ALWAYS HAVE A 4 HOUR TIME MARKING.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE PROCEED TO ENGAGE IN FOOD PREPARATION AFTER RETURNING TO KITCHEN FROM THROWING OUT TRASH WITHOUT WASHING HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS ONCE RETURNING TO KITCHEN FOR FOOD PREPARATION ACTIVITIES. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: BROWN RICE IN 2 DOOR PREP TOP (LEFT) AND SWEET AND SOUR CHICKEN PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR IN 2 DOOR PREP TOP (RIGHT).
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED DATE MARKED LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): POOLED EGGS, GARLIC IN OIL ON CART NEAR WOK LINE, COOKED NOODLES AND CUT CABBAGE ON COUNTER TOP WITHOUT 4 HOUR TIME LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS AT THE END OF THE 4 HOUR TIME PERIOD DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE PROPER DOCUMENTATION AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: SPOON USE TO SERVE RICE IN CONTAINER OF WATER AT 67F; KNIFE STORED BETWEEN PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED SPOON WITH WATER AND KNIFE TO BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED. CLEAN SPOON WAS PLACED IN EMPTY CONTAINER.
